protocol_freeze_receipt.purpose: Prove the sample, blinding, lock, escalation, scope, and six agreement gates were frozen before author labels.

author_audit_sampling_receipt.purpose: Prove a hash-deterministic 900-second primary sample and at most 900-second disjoint reserve independent of model outputs and content quality.

pseudo_annotation_receipt.purpose: Prove full-pilot local pseudo-annotation, license/hash provenance, network isolation, quarantine confinement, and learner/evaluation separation.

author_workflow_receipt.purpose: Prove the loopback-only AUTHOR_AUDIT_A route is populated, resumable, prediction-blinded, and irreversibly lockable.

author_audit_result_receipt.purpose: Report only aggregate locked model-human agreement and threshold dispositions; never author labels or model payloads.

decision_rules.ready: Every preparation, privacy, isolation, sampling, and workflow condition passes; no completed author result exists.
decision_rules.go: A qualified-author record was blinded and irreversibly locked before reveal, and every frozen agreement gate passes.
decision_rules.revise: Any required receipt is incomplete, a bounded technical issue remains, or a non-fundamental frozen gate does not pass.
decision_rules.stop: A reproducible local-instrument incompatibility remains after bounded correction, or a locked qualified-author audit explicitly establishes fundamental calibration failure.
